Analysis reveals a structured pattern of transactions just below $10,000 to evade CTR reporting, including wire transfers to high-risk jurisdictions (UAE, Cyprus, Hong Kong). Graph analysis confirms layering through intermediary accounts ACC-10088 and ACC-10099, with funds ultimately distributed to offshore entities Meridian Holdings Ltd and Eastern Star Consulting. External fraud database checks indicate prior 314(b) inquiries and association with a synthetic identity ring. Total suspicious activity volume: $284,750. Account ACC-10042 has been frozen pending investigation; related accounts also temporarily restricted. Prior SAR (SAR-2026-00147) filed for structuring suspicion. Activity consistent with trade-based money laundering and use of shell companies.
